typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsProductSwap_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		SWAP_TYPE as string,
		OPTION_TYPE as string,
		LEG_TYPE as string,
		DIRECTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromProductSwap
fromProductSwap derive({Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID),
		{Copy of DIRECTION} = DIRECTION,
		{Copy of SWAP_TYPE} = SWAP_TYPE,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_ID} = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		{Copy of LEG_TYPE} = LEG_TYPE,
		{Copy of OPTION_TYPE} = OPTION_TYPE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		swap_type as string,
		trade_id as string,
		leg_type as string,
		option_type as string,
		product_id as string,
		direction as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		swap_type = {Copy of SWAP_TYPE},
		trade_id = {Copy of TRADE_ID},
		leg_type = {Copy of LEG_TYPE},
		option_type = {Copy of OPTION_TYPE},
		product_id = {Copy of PRODUCT_ID},
		direction = {Copy of DIRECTION}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsProductSwap_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsProductSwap
